Operation.description: This operation is used to update AM Rule properties and accessor privileges for the input AM Rule and Named ACL.
Operation.name: updateAMRuleAndACL2
Operation.returnDescription:
If all actions defined on the input are successful, the ServiceData will contain objects that are updated. Updated AM_tree, AM_ACL objects are added to the updated list. If any errors are encountered, the following partial errors may be returned:

525500    The given object is not a valid AM_tree object. Please provide a valid object.
525501    The given object is not a valid AM_ACL object. Please provide a valid object.
525502    Nulls not allowed in attribute AM_tree: rule_name.
Operation.useCase:
1) To update string or reference properties of an Access Manager rule, the client should pass a unique client id, a reference to the AM_tree and property maps containing the name and new value for each property to be modified in the UpdateAMRuleInfo. Supported string properties are rule name, rule_arg and description. Supported reference properties are acl.

2) To add object based accessor privileges to a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo2 aceInfo list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the ADD_ACE action, a reference to the accessor, and a list of PrivilegeInfo containing the privileges to be Allowed, Denied or Unset.

3) To remove the object accesor privileges from a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo2 aceInfo list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain REMOVE_ACE action and a reference to the accessor that should be removed.

4) To modify object based accessor privileges of a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo2 aceInfo list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the MODIFY_ACE action, a reference to the accessor and a list of PrivilegeInfo containing the privileges and their new values.

5) To change the accessor with privileges for a Named ACL, the client should pass both an input structure to remove the current accessor privileges from the AM_ACL (See 3 above) and a structure to add the new accessor privileges to the AM_ACL (see 2 above).

6) To add accessor privileges for a property group to an Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACE and add an UpdateAttributeACEInfo to the UpdateAttributeACLInfo attrAceInfo list. The UpdateAttributeACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the ADD_ACE action, a reference to the accessor, a reference to the Fnd0AlsGroup, and a list of privileges for the new accessor.

7) To remove accessor privileges to a property group from an Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateAttributeACEInfo to the UpdateAttributeACLInfo attrAceInfo list. The UpdateAttributeACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the REMOVE_ACE action, a reference to the accessor and a reference to a Fnd0AlsGroup.

8) To change the property group or accessor of an existing the accessor and property group for an Named ACL, the client should pass both an input structure to delete privileges for the existing accessor and property group (See 7 above) and a structure to add the existing accessor privileges to the new property group (see 6 above).

525502    Nulls not allowed in attribute AM_tree:rule_name.
525503    The given object is not a valid Fnd0AlsAcl. Please provide a valid object.
Operation.useCase:
1) To update string or reference properties of an Access Manager rule, the client should pass a unique client id, a reference to the AM_tree and property maps containing the name and new value for each property to be modified in the UpdateAMRuleInfo. Supported string properties are rule name, rule_arg and description. Supported reference properties are acl and fnd0AlsAcl.

2) To add accessor privileges to a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo updates list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the ADD_ACE action, a reference to the accessor, and a list of PrivilegeInfo containing the privileges to be Allowed, Denied or Unset.

3) To remove the accesor privileges from a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo updates list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain REMOVE_ACE action and a reference to the accessor that should be removed.

4) To modify accessor privileges of a Named ACL, the client should pass a reference to the AM_ACL and add an UpdateACEInfo to the UpdateACLInfo updates list. The UpdateACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the MODIFY_ACE action, a reference to the accessor and a list of PrivilegeInfo containing the privileges and their new values.

5) To change the accessor with privileges for a Named ACL, the client should pass both an input structure to remove the current accessor privileges from the Named ACL (See 3 above) and a structure to add the new accessor privileges Named ACL (see 2 above).

6) To add accessor privileges for a property group to an Attribute ACL, the client should pass a reference to the Fnd0AlsACL and add an UpdateAttributeACEInfo to the UpdateAttributeACLInfo updates list. The UpdateAttributeACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the ADD_ACE action, a reference to the accessor, a reference to the Fnd0AlsGroup, and a list of privileges for the new accessor.

7) To remove accessor privileges to a property group from an attribute ACL, the client should pass a reference to the Fnd0AlsACL and add an UpdateAttributeACEInfo to the UpdateAttributeACLInfo updates list. The UpdateAttributeACEInfo should contain a unique client id, the REMOVE_ACE action, a reference to the accessor and a reference to a Fnd0AlsGroup.

8) To change the property group or accessor of an existing the accessor and property group for an attribute ACL, the client should pass both an input structure to delete privileges for the existing accessor and property group (See 7 above) and a structure to add the existing accessor privileges to the new property group (see 6 above).
